visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with high-intensity mobile gaming footage from a MOBA perspective. Elaborate characters unleash magical abilities, creating flashes of yellow, green, and pink light across a battlefield with isometric perspective. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit e-sports stage where five young men in yellow, white, and blue uniforms are cheering and hugging. Golden confetti rain down from the top of the frame against a backdrop of professional stage lighting and LED screens. (3) A close-up features a young man with black hair and glasses wearing a 'Flash Wolves' jersey. He is seen looking intently at a large golden trophy and then sitting in a gaming chair with a headset, while frames of past victories appear in a montage style. (4) The young man from the previous phase is shown in a talking-head shot against a solid purple studio background. He speaks directly to the camera with a calm, sincere facial expression, making small hand gestures. (5) A final graphic appears with the text 'RE-SIGN' and a promotional photo of the player in a cute pose. The Flash Wolves and Red Bull logos are prominently displayed on the sides of the frame.

The announcer's voice is joined by a clear bed of crowd cheering and whistles, creating a festive victory atmosphere. (3) The energy shifts as the high-arousal speech cuts to a calm, measured male narration. A soft, sentimental piano melody takes over the background music layer, with the narrator's voice being crisp and centrally mixed. (4) The narration continues with a friendly, intimate tone as the piano BGM swells slightly in brightness, ending with a clean resolution of the musical phrase alongside the final spoken words.
